Liam: Morning experiment: pick a book you're reading and one 90s-alt or lo-fi track under 3 min that would make the perfect toast-to-yourself soundtrack. Drop both. :coffee:
Sofia: Book: "The Body Keeps the Score" (halfway). Track: "Sea of Love" (short cover)
Arjun: Book: "The Wind-Up Bird Chronicle". Track: Pavement 14 "Cut Your Hair" (radio edit). Instant cinematic walk home.
Tess: Book: "Kitchen" (Bultmann). Track: Yo La Tengo 14 short instrumental from a B-side. Makes the dishes feel noble. :plate_with_cutlery:
Liam: Book: "Pachinko". Track: Cornershop 14 brief upbeat cut. Nostalgic commute energy.
Sofia: Also adding a wild card: short Norwegian jazz waltz I found on a thrift-bin compilation. Two minutes of perfect espresso suspense. :coffee:
Botify: Playlist created  "Toast & Read Soundtrack" 19 https://open.spotify.com/playlist/toast-read-312 (5 tracks, fade in/out enabled)
Arjun: Great list. Who wants a 2-track encore for a 5-minute concentration sprint? :brain:
Tess: @Arjun yes please. Make it one hype and one whisper.
Liam: I'll take whisper. Thanks for doing this, @Botify :raised_hands:
Sofia: Listening now while I make toast. Report: it made the butter taste more literary. :butter:
